sounds.prompt: Seamless heavy industrial hydraulic carriage extending outward along steel rails inside a huge arena. Deep powerful piston pressure, gritty geared motor drive, heavy metal rollers. Steady movement only, no start or stop impact, no voices or music.

Seamless heavy industrial hydraulic carriage retracting into a wall on steel rails. Low strained winch motor, grinding gear teeth and hydraulic suction hiss. Steady movement only, no start or stop impact, no voices or music.

Seamless armored steel sci fi arena shutter rising on mechanical guide rails. Mid low electric servo whirr, textured metal sliding scrape, pneumatic air hiss. Steady movement only without a final slam, no alarms, no voices or music.

Seamless heavy armored steel shutter lowering on industrial guide rails. Low grinding motor and heavy metal sliding scrape, pneumatic pressure. Steady movement only without a final slam, no alarms, no voices or music.
One short heavy industrial metal mechanism locking into place, a solid bassy mechanical clunk with a brief hydraulic pressure release, short enclosed arena echo. No voices, no music, no explosions.
